description: List the register of agent and software optimisations (what was proposed, ticketed, implemented, measured or rejected — with evidence and measured effect). Optional filters: id (returns the full event history), status (current state: vorgeschlagen|ticket|umgesetzt|gemessen|verworfen), art (agent|software|algorithmus), ziel_id (e.g. an agent id), ablauf, seit (YYYY-MM-DD, created on/after), mit_plattform (default true: include platform-wide software items), limit (default 50, max 200). Each entry carries stand (latest event), stand_am, letzte_messung. Read-only.

ablauf.description: Only optimisations for this workflow type

art.description: Only optimisations of this kind (agent, software, algorithmus)

id.description: ID of one optimisation; returns its full event history

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

mit_plattform.description: Include platform-wide software items; default true

seit.description: Only optimisations created on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

name: list_optimierungen
